Snapchat Sued Over Minor's Rape Allegations Linked to App Features

A lawsuit has been filed against Snap Inc. alleging that features within its Snapchat app facilitated the rape of a minor. The suit claims the company failed to disable dangerous features or adequately warn parents about potential harms. Specifically, the recommendation system and Snap Maps are cited as tools that allegedly aided in the exploitation of a 12-year-old girl, despite age restrictions.
